guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Create Your SoSoValue Account
guide.description: Visit SoSoValue and sign up with email or a wallet. The same account works across the web platform and the iOS and Android apps.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Earn EXP Through Platform Tasks
guide.description: Open the EXP page from the badge in the top-right of the SoSoValue interface and complete Starter Pack and daily tasks. These include exploring dashboards, learning about SSI indexes, the daily check-in, and inviting friends with your referral link. This Season 3 path is free and does not require any capital.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect a Wallet and Add ValueChain
guide.description: Connect MetaMask or another Web3 wallet, then add the ValueChain network so you can hold SSI tokens and trade on SoDEX. Fund the wallet with USDC, which you can buy on Binance if you need it, or bridge directly using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a n
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Buy SSI Index Tokens
guide.description: Open the SSI page and buy one of the index products based on the sector exposure you want: MAG7.ssi: a large-cap basket index DEFI.ssi: a DeFi sector index MEME.ssi: a meme sector index USSI: a USD-denominated index
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake Your SSI Tokens
guide.description: Go to the Stake to Earn tab and stake your index tokens. Holding earns a 3x point multiplier, but staking raises it to 15x, so staked positions earn far more Loyalty Points. There is a 14-day cooldown before you can withdraw staked tokens.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit into the SoDEX Vault
guide.description: Deposit sMAG7.ssi or MAG7.ssi into the SoDEX Vault to earn passive SoPoints on top of your staking rewards, adding the extra APR layer with no extra trading.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade on SoDEX to Earn SoPoints
guide.description: Head to SoDEX and trade spot or perpetual pairs. Trading volume is the most effective way to earn SoPoints, and the dynamic weighting model rewards steady, organic activity over one-time spikes.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake SOSO and Invite Friends
guide.description: Stake SOSO in the Reward tab to boost your Loyalty Points. Once you pass 1,000 USDC in SoDEX volume, you can unlock a referral code that pays 10% fee rebates and 25% of your invitees’ points with no cap.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your SOSO Rewards
guide.description: Rewards are distributed by smart contract after each epoch ends. Return to the Reward page when the claim window opens, connect your wallet, and claim your SOSO within the 90-day window.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
